from __future__ import annotations

import os

from fastapi import FastAPI, Header, HTTPException

from app.routers import levels, orders, transfers, returns, audits

app = FastAPI(title="Inventory Service", version="0.1.0")


@app.middleware("http")
async def require_shared_token(request, call_next):
    if request.url.path == "/healthz":
        return await call_next(request)
    expected = os.environ.get("INVENTORY_SHARED_TOKEN")
    if not expected:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="INVENTORY_SHARED_TOKEN not configured")
    if request.headers.get("x-inventory-token") != expected:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid shared token")
    return await call_next(request)


@app.get("/healthz")
def healthz() -> dict:
    return {"ok": True}


app.include_router(levels.router)
app.include_router(orders.router)
app.include_router(transfers.router)
app.include_router(returns.router)
app.include_router(audits.router)
